newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Air France opens Asia-Pacific HQ in HK.
newsitem.headline: Air France opens Asia-Pacific HQ in HK.

text.p: Air France said on Sunday it has opened its first Asia Pacific headquarters in Hong Kong, which would spearhead the company's regional growth plans.

"Starting in 1997, we will begin a programme of increasing the frequency of flights from Asia to Europe and increase the capacity on our planes," said its Asia Pacific Managing Director Arthur Bullard in a statement.
The company's sales and marketing strategies in Asia, previously done from Paris, would now be developed and implemented from Hong Kong, it said.
Air France routes cover 14 cities in 11 regional countries, including Japan, Hong Kong, China, India, New Caledonia, Korea, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines and Vietnam.
